Could you confirm whether this is expected behaviour tied to the sync process?

tickets.subject: Dashboard still showing stale currency rates
tickets.body: Related to the alert thresholds from earlier this week - the consolidation dashboard is also pulling currency conversion rates that appear to be several days old, which doesn't match what we understood about the connector applying live rates. Given the timing so close to the alert issue, we suspect these might share a root cause on the connector side. We've built a manual rate-check step into our month-end process in the meantime, so there's no immediate pressure, but wanted both issues logged together.

tickets.subject: Dashboards very slow to load
tickets.body: Our operations dashboard has been slow all week, sometimes 30-40 seconds to render. It's disrupting our morning routine. Could someone check what's going on?

tickets.subject: Alerts delayed by hours
tickets.body: Alerts that should fire within minutes of a threshold breach are arriving hours late, sometimes not at all. Combined with the slow dashboards last month, it's starting to feel like a pattern.

tickets.body: Coming back to the alert delay issue from the spring - it's back, and worse. Eight days to get an answer on a delayed alert is not something we can plan operations around.

tickets.subject: Still no fix on alerts
tickets.body: No update since our last ticket in October. Alerts are still unreliable and it's affecting how much we trust the platform for anything time-sensitive.

tickets.body: I'd like this escalated. The alert issue from last year was never properly resolved, and now our exports have started failing too. We need a plan, not another queue ticket.

Could you check whether this is related to load on your end, or something with how we're querying?

tickets.subject: Export formatting broken for warehouse reports
tickets.body: The scheduled exports for our warehouse stock reports have started coming out with merged header rows and shifted columns, which means someone has to manually reformat the file before it goes to the wider ops team each week. This is the kind of manual overhead we specifically wanted to avoid by automating exports in the first place. As part of our operations tooling review this year we've also had a look at Storsund BI, partly prompted by these kinds of formatting issues recurring across a few modules.

tickets.subject: Connector timeout pattern - more data
tickets.body: Following on from the export formatting issue last month, we're also still seeing the intermittent API timeouts from December, now roughly one in three calls during our morning sync window specifically. We've built retry logic robust enough that it isn't blocking reporting, but the frequency has increased rather than settled down. Storsund BI's team demoed a comparable connector setup for us last week as part of the review, and it was useful to see how another platform handles retry and backoff, for context if it helps your side too.

tickets.subject: Dashboard load times - quiet flag
tickets.body: Not urgent, but noting that the warehouse dashboards have been slow to load consistently since the connector issues earlier in the year - 15 to 20 seconds for the main stock overview, versus a couple of seconds when we first set this up. We've adjusted our own expectations around when we check it during the day rather than push for a fix immediately, so no need to prioritise this over anything else in the queue.

tickets.subject: Alert reliability - following up ahead of Q3
tickets.body: It's been two months since Matti raised the question about failure-triggered alerts, and we still don't have a working notification for failed API pulls, which means we're back to someone manually checking the overnight job each morning before close. We'd appreciate a clearer answer before Q3 reporting ramps up, though we've adapted our process enough that it isn't a crisis.

tickets.subject: Manual monitoring routine now in place - closing the loop
tickets.body: Since Erik's note last week, we've gone ahead and built our own monitoring script that pings the API and alerts our team directly if a scheduled pull fails, so we're no longer relying on the platform's alerting for this specific case. tickets.body: The blank dashboard issue from last summer is back, affecting a different set of users this time. I'd like to know if this is actually the same underlying bug.

tickets.subject: Escalating - recurring dashboard failures
tickets.body: This is the second dashboard outage in a week and the fourth issue overall since June. I want this escalated - we need someone to actually diagnose the root cause, not just restart the service.

tickets.subject: API down again - still waiting on escalation
tickets.body: API is failing again, no response yet to last month's escalation. At this point I need a proper timeline, not another 'looking into it'.

tickets.subject: Connector question after a quiet few months
tickets.body: Things have actually been stable since the escalation call in the spring - appreciated. Setting up a new connector for our warehouse system, any config notes I should know?

tickets.subject: Dashboards holding up well
tickets.body: No repeat of the blank-screen issue in months now. Small cosmetic bug: the legend on the trend chart overlaps the title on narrow screens.

tickets.subject: Seat swap request
tickets.body: Need to swap a seat from a departing analyst to their replacement. Straightforward one, hoping it's quick given how smooth things have been lately.

tickets.subject: Export format question
tickets.body: Is there a native export format for Power BI, or do we need to go through CSV as an intermediate step?

tickets.subject: Report builder template sharing
tickets.body: Can a report template be shared across workspaces, or does each workspace need its own copy built separately?

tickets.subject: Export size limit
tickets.body: What's the maximum row count for a single export before it needs to be split into batches?

tickets.subject: API rate limit hit unexpectedly
tickets.body: We hit the API rate limit today despite not changing our polling frequency. Had to pause our integration for a few hours. Could you check if the limit changed recently?

tickets.subject: Connector sync stuck
tickets.body: Our main connector has been stuck 'syncing' for over six hours with no data coming through. Following the rate-limit surprise last week, this is the second odd thing in a fortnight.

tickets.subject: Exports failing since the connector fix
tickets.body: Since the connector issue from February got sorted, exports have started failing instead - eleven days now without a working scheduled export. Feels like whack-a-mole at this point.

tickets.subject: Alerts wrong for two weeks
tickets.body: Our alerts have been firing on stale data for what looks like two weeks. Between this and the export problem in June, I'm struggling to trust the numbers we're getting.

tickets.subject: Alerts broken again - fourteen days to fix last time
tickets.body: Same alert issue as August, and it took two weeks to sort last time. Please tell me this one moves faster.

tickets.subject: Dashboard showing wrong totals
tickets.body: Our summary dashboard is showing totals that don't match the underlying report. Fifth issue this year and each one chips away at confidence in the platform.

tickets.subject: Escalating - API unreliable for a year now
tickets.body: I'd like this escalated properly. Going back to February, we've had API problems, connector problems, export problems, alert problems twice, and a dashboard problem - almost one a month. We need a real fix, not another ticket.

tickets.subject: Dashboard issue while waiting on escalation
tickets.body: Another dashboard glitch while we wait to hear back on the escalation from two days ago. Numbers off by roughly 10% on the operations view.

tickets.subject: Still waiting - third dashboard issue this month
tickets.body: Third dashboard problem in January alone. We haven't had a substantive response to the escalation yet either.

tickets.subject: Exports stable, thanks
tickets.body: Wanted to note that exports have been solid for a few months now since the escalation call. Small ask: can we get a warning email before a scheduled export silently skips due to no new data?

tickets.subject: Dashboard consistency check
tickets.body: Dashboards have matched the underlying reports consistently since the changes went in. Appreciate the follow-through this time.

tickets.subject: API stability check-in
tickets.body: No rate-limit surprises or failures on the API side in months now. Is there a status page we can bookmark instead of guessing when something's off?

tickets.subject: Minor export cosmetic issue
tickets.body: Tiny thing - the export filename still uses the old date format (DDMMYYYY) rather than ISO. Not urgent, just noting it while things are otherwise running well.

tickets.subject: Dashboard tile request
tickets.body: Given how stable things have been, would it be worth adding a tile type for cumulative year-to-date totals? Would save us a manual report each month.

tickets.subject: Export automation question
tickets.body: Can a scheduled export trigger a webhook once complete, so we can automate the next step in our pipeline?

tickets.subject: New connector for logistics data
tickets.body: Looking to add a connector for our logistics partner's data feed. Is there a standard one, or would this be a custom build?

tickets.subject: Connector permissions question
tickets.body: Can a specific connector be restricted to only certain users, or do all admins see all connectors by default?

tickets.subject: API documentation update
tickets.body: Noticed the API docs for the exports endpoint are a version behind what's actually live. Not blocking us, just flagging it.

tickets.subject: Connector sync failing — authentication error
tickets.body:
Our HubSpot connector started throwing authentication errors this morning, syncs are failing. Credentials haven't changed. Can you check if there's something on your side?

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Connector sync schedule — not running at configured time
tickets.body:
Our data connector is set to sync at 06:00 but it's been running anywhere between 06:00 and 08:30 over the past week. We rely on the data being fresh for our morning reports. Is there a queueing issue?

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: API — filter parameter not working as documented
tickets.body:
The `filter[date_range]` parameter in the reports endpoint doesn't seem to respect the end date boundary — results include records from the following day. Per the docs, the range should be inclusive. Please advise.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Connector failing silently again — no error notifications
tickets.body:
Our connector has been failing since Wednesday and we only found out because the dashboards were showing stale data. There were no error notifications sent despite alerts being configured. This isn't the first time this has happened. The lack of visibility is making it difficult to trust the platform for operational reporting. Please look into both the connector failure and why alerts didn't fire.

Tero Lindqvist
Head of Operations

tickets.subject: Report builder — calculated fields giving wrong results
tickets.body:
A calculated field using a percentage formula is returning incorrect values when the denominator is zero — it should return null or 0 but instead shows garbage. Reports are going out to management with wrong numbers in them. This needs to be fixed urgently.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: API breaking changes — no advance notice
tickets.body:
Our integration broke last week due to a change in the API response format — a field was renamed without any deprecation notice or changelog entry. We lost two days of pipeline output before we found the cause. We need proper advance notice for breaking changes. What is your API versioning policy?

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Report scheduler broken — AGAIN
tickets.body:
Report scheduler is not sending scheduled reports. This is the third distinct issue with report delivery this quarter. Reports just don't arrive, no error in the UI, nothing in the log I can access. My team has stopped relying on scheduled delivery and is exporting manually every morning.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: API returning 500 on /metrics endpoint
tickets.body:
Getting consistent 500 errors from the /metrics endpoint since yesterday afternoon. Nothing changed on our side. This is blocking our daily data pull entirely.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Report builder — formatting lost on save
tickets.body:
Column formatting in saved reports keeps reverting. Every time we open a saved report, number formatting on currency columns is gone. We've reported formatting bugs before and each fix seems to introduce a new one. Honestly getting tired of the quality of this module.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: API key permissions — read-only key has write access
tickets.body:
Read-only API key appears to have write permissions it shouldn't. Please check and correct.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: API response latency — degraded for two days
tickets.body:
API response times have been significantly higher than usual since Monday. P95 is around 4s, was previously under 800ms. Not blocking us but worth flagging.

Tero Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Alert recipient groups - question
tickets.body: Can alert recipient groups be nested, so that a change to a department's group membership automatically updates who receives the relevant alerts, rather than us maintaining a separate list per alert? Trying to reduce the admin overhead of keeping alert subscriptions in sync with our org chart as the team grows.

tickets.subject: Connector sync failures - no clear pattern
tickets.body: Our warehouse connector has failed intermittently over the past couple of weeks, sometimes syncing fine for days and then failing twice in one morning, without any consistent error message we can point to. We've started cross-checking the numbers manually when something looks off, which has become part of our routine now. Separately, we had a look at Dashlume this month as part of a general review of reporting tools, mainly prompted by wanting more visibility into sync reliability generally.

tickets.subject: Export issues on top of the connector problems
tickets.body: On top of the connector sync issues from October, our scheduled exports have also started arriving with outdated figures roughly once a week, presumably tied to the same underlying reliability question. We've adjusted our process so someone spot-checks each export against the live dashboard before it goes out, which takes a few extra minutes but catches the problem when it happens. Still keeping half an eye on Dashlume as part of our review, though nothing decided yet. No urgency on our end for now.
